entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I've had it for about twelve days and I think I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a personal preference?
It's definitely a preference. Honestly, the interface is pretty confusing. The user manual didn't help much, and I just find it hard to use during my rides. I really expected more from it, you know?
I understand. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit for your needs. Let me just pull up your order information and review the policy for you. One moment.
Sure. If a full return isn't possible since it's been a little bit, would a partial credit or a discount on a different product be an option? I'm willing to be flexible.
Okay, I have your account here. It looks like the delivery was 12 days ago. That's no problem at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's fantastic. I was worried I'd missed the window. That makes things much simpler.

Absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off at the post office.
Perfect, I see the email now. Thank you so much for making that so easy, Sarah. I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
